title: Den Fears
summary: Den Fears is a courageous young orphan and the older brother of Harrison Fears. Forced to join the Blood Spiral with his brother, Den quickly saw through their cruel ideals and walked away, joining the Huntik Foundation and pitting himself against Harrison, who stayed with the Spirals. Den subsequently joined Dante's team as a replacement for Zhalia Moon when she left to infiltrate the Blood Spiral, his troubled past giving him an edge in mastering dark and sinister Titans, notably his signature swordsman, Vigilante. Yet a rookie in the Seeker world, Den, like Lok Lambert before him, has quickly become an accomplished Seeker and one of the Foundation's main agents.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
, Vigilante]]
Den never knew his parents, and was raised with his brother, Harrison, in an orphanage in Rotterdam, Netherlands, the same orphanage where Zhalia Moon had lived years earlier. Den would often protect his brother from bullies around the orphanage, unknowingly using his latent Seeker abilities. When the Blood Spiral took interest in the orphanage, Tantras began to teach the orphans to become his Silent Soldiers. Den showed remarkable potential, initially catching the eye of Tantras, but he failed to bond with the Marauder Amulet as he refused to give in to his darker emotions and become a bully to others. This aggravated Tantras, and as the brothers debated about joining the Spiral, Zhalia appeared with a warning. [Den vs Harrison]

After magically being marked with the symbol of the Spiral by Rassimov, Den decided against this life, refusing to hurt people for no good reason. However, Harrison decided to remain with Tantras, and bitterly resented Den for, from his perspective, abandoning him. As Den joined Zhalia, a conflict between the Blood Spiral and the Huntik Foundation erupted on the Erasmus Bridge, during which Den managed to bond with the Amulet of Vigilante which Lok Lambert had dropped. After the battle, Den went to Dante's house with Dante Vale's team. [Den vs Harrison]

Welcomed into the Huntik Foundation, Den began training at Huntik Foundation Italian HQ, but would take time out to play with Lok and Cherit, at one time playing a large scale game of chess. [The Legendary Titan of Fate] 
 gives his Freelancer to Den]]
After long periods of intense concentration and training under the guidance of Clease, Den soon grew bored and frustrated at his lack of improvement. After accidentally wrecking the HQ library, Den was asked by Lok, Sophie and Dante to join their team, having been recommended by Zhalia herself to replace her to which he happily agreed. However, overwhelmed by the responsibility, Den ran away, determined to find Harrison by himself. After being attacked by his former fellow orphans, now official students of the Blood Spiral, he was rescued by Lok, Cherit and Powerbonded Kipperin. Upon realizing the Spirals were after Den, Lok gave him his Freelancer Amulet stating they would be a good match. After meeting the Tantras and his students for a confrontation, Den took on his brother, considerably more powerful and brutal, and with Cherit and Freelancer's help was able to defeat him. Den nearly took Harrison to the Huntik Foundation, but Zhalia Moon used a Darksleep on Den to prevent such an occurrence and earn Tantras' trust. Now part of the team, Den returned to studying now with Lok helping him. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

Over time, a growth in experience shaped Den to become both braver and stronger. His first adventure outside the city in Mexico saw him get kidnapped by Kiel and Marduk, however he did not let this break his confidence and helped Cherit and Lok activate the Blue Star. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun] The Huntik Foundation Council were also impressed with his bravery and gave him a new Titan, Cursed Archer, which he used whilst assisting Dante in the Great Rift Valley, Africa. [Sophie on Trial] His fortitude showed immensely when he joined Dante and Lok in taking on an entire army of Blood Spiral soldiers whilst defending the Fortress of Iron Will. [The Spiral War]

 and Kaioh the Tracker in Hernán Cortés's vault]]
Whilst staying in Baja California, Mexico, Den befriended a native American Seeker named Teeg who gave him the Amulet of Kaioh the Tracker. Den later used Kaioh in Hernán Cortés' vault, which proved vital in finding the Ring of Umbra the Shadow Jaguar. [The Power of Umbra]

Brought closer by their numerous adventures together, Den grew to look up to Lok as a brother as compared to Harrison, who he now considered an illusion of his past self. [An Ally from the Organization] Den took to the experience of feeling part of a family when staying at the Lambert house, with Sandra Lambert growing very fond of him. Whilst in Ireland, Den found the Amulet of Dullahan the headless knight in the ruins of Tír na nÓg. [Back Home]

On the longest night of the year, Den and the Huntik team travelled to Nostradamus' tomb where they found the last quatrain. Experiencing great pain from his tattoo, Den warned the team that they were almost out of time. After a battle with Marduk and his men, Den and the team were teleported by Umbra to the Spiral Mark. [Words from Eathon] Determined to find his brother once and for all, Den thanked the team for everything before bidding them farewell and using Camoforge to become invisible and enter the Blood Spiral Base. [The Spiral Mark]

Upon finding Harrison, a fierce battle ensued between the two, with Den powerbonding with Vigilante. However, cave-in resulted in them being rescued by Zhalia Moon and Kilthane, who brought them to safety. After witnessing Zhalia at the mercy of the Betrayer, Harrison realized he was fighting on the wrong side and used Powermark on Kilthane to revive Den, whom he begged for help. Back together, they joined forces to attack the Betrayer. [Lok and the Betrayer] Den helped the newly reunited Huntik team defeat the Betrayer and witnessed Dante's return from the ashes. After the defeat of the Blood Spiral, he was seen reunited with Harrison and, later, standing with the team in the rain forest with Lok as their new team leader. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.text:
Den is very playful and likes to think highly of himself, often boasting about his deeds. [Back Home] However, he is very protective of people he cares for. He is fearless and will fight to the end with his enemies. Den doesn't hold a grudge against the world for being an orphan, as his younger brother Harrison does. He often defends the weak ones. [Den vs Harrison] Den has also shown himself to be a fast learner and someone who wants to use his newly found powers to help others in need. [Boys Will Be Seekers] It is for this reason that he idolizes Lok, who has taken him under his wing as a teacher and older brother. Den's loyalty towards led him to risk his own safety to save him from Hoffman's Trapcage power in the Vault of Cortes [The Power of Umbra] and he tried to encourage Lok when he became devoid of hope during the final battle. [Dante's Return] For Den, Lok is the ideal super hero and hopes to follow in his footsteps and one day be his equal. [An Ally from the Organization]

Den is also a big eater, often keen to find a place to get food. [Sophie on Trial] [Gremlow Infestation!] He thoroughly enjoyed the home cooking of both Teeg [The Power of Umbra] and Sandra Lambert. [Back Home] He develops a crush on Emi, a Foundation Seeker, and tries to impress her, but admits he has a lot to learn about how to talk to girls. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E37 Den summons Vigilante.png|thumb|Den summons the dark [[Titan]], [[Vigilante]]]]
Den discovered his Seeker powers whilst defending his brother from bullies at his orphanage. {{source|Den vs Harrison}} He is a fast learner and quite athletic, always willing to try new moves in combat. {{source|The Casterwill Connection}} Den's strong dark side allows him to bond with sinister [[Titans]] like [[Vigilante]] and [[Cursed Archer]], thus making him valuable to the team whilst his resistance to evil is clear through how he failed to bond with [[Marauder]], whose [[Amulet]] he was given by [[Tantras]].

sections.heading: Bonded Titans
sections.text:
Cursed Archer — A dark Titan given to him by the Huntik Foundation when he met the Huntik Council in New York.

Dullahan — Den recovered its Amulet in the floating castle of Tír na nÓg in Ireland.

Freelancer — Lok gave his loyal knightly Titan to Den to help him on his journey, in the same way Dante gave it to him.

Kaioh the Tracker — Given by Teeg in Baja California, Kaioh quickly became one of Den's most distinctive Titans.

Vigilante, Powerbonded — Den's first and signature Titan, they bonded instantly during a battle on the Erasmus Bridge; with his Powerbonded Cindercloak ability, he can transform into a magical armor for Den to wear.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* According to the 17th issue of ''Huntik Magazine'', Den is 14 years old.
* With the exception of [[Kaioh the Tracker]], all of Den's Titans are [[Draco-Titans]].
* Den's Italian voice actor, Francesco Graziano, is famous for providing Naruto's voice in the ''Naruto'' anime.
* Den's name is a variant of the Greek name ''Dennis'', meaning "follower of Dionysius," or of the Old English name ''Dennison'', meaning "son of Dennis." His last name is derived from the English word ''fear''. {{extsource|http://www.thinkbabynames.com/meaning/1/Den|ThinkBabyNames.com}}

*[[Farslip]] *[[Featherdrop]] *[[Hidesight]] *[[Hyperstride]] *[[Nimblefire]] *[[Raypulse]] *[[Spidertouch]] {{SpellColEnd}} ===Bonded Titans=== {{TitanCollection}} {{TitanRow|[[Cursed Archer]]| | | A dark Titan given to him by the [[Huntik Foundation]] when he met the [[Huntik Foundation Council|Huntik Council]] in [[New York]]. }} {{TitanRow|[[Dullahan]] | | | Den recovered its Amulet in the floating castle of [[Tír na nÓg]] in [[Ireland]]. }} {{TitanRow|[[Freelancer]] | | | [[Lok]] gave his loyal knightly Titan to Den to help him on his journey, in the same way [[Dante]] gave it to him.}} {{TitanRow|[[Kaioh the Tracker]] | | | Given by [[Teeg]] in Baja California, Kaioh quickly became one of Den's most distinctive Titans. }} {{TitanRow|[[Vigilante|Vigilante, Powerbonded]] | | | Den's first and signature Titan, they bonded instantly during a battle on the [[Erasmus Bridge]]; with his Powerbonded Cindercloak ability, he can transform into a magical armor for Den to wear. }} Den's name is a variant of the Greek name ''Dennis'', meaning "follower of Dionysius," or of the Old English name ''Dennison'', meaning "son of Dennis."
